player_prompt.intro:
Kwizihiza ku mazi ya Frozen!

Uwakiriwe na 'P' kuri grid.
Ibirizi bya grid:
  ' ' = Ubuso bwo ku mazi (si buhimbaza)
  'H' = Izuba (ukagwa utakaza!
  'G' = Intego (ukagwa utazihiza!
  'P' = Ahantu kaho uko

Ibikorwa biruhushwa: hejuru, hejuru, kuri gushyu, kuri guse: (cyangwa w, a, s, d)
Andika ikintu cyawe kama: [up], [down], [left], [right] cyangwa [w], [a], [s], [d]

Intego: Hinda uhinduka kuva kuri kijyambere (hejuru-kubere) hadi kuri intego (kurema-kuruma) binyuze mu nzira isukuye!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifishi y'ikintu si yo nziza. Utumiye [up], [down], [left], [right] cyangwa [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Igikorwa kitazwi '{action}'. Koresha hejuru, hepfo, ibumoso, iburyo cyangwa w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Warije kwihama {action} ariko warutse kuri uruzitiro!

outcome.win: Urakoze cyane! Wageze ku ntego yawe.
outcome.fell_in_hole: Waguye mu rwobo! Umukino urarangiye. Washoje {pct}% y'urugendo ugana ku izamu.
outcome.turn_limit: Mwageze ku mupaka w'ijya n'irisoba! Umukino urarangiye. Mwarangije {pct}% y'urugendo mugana ku ntego.
